Working notes:

- Option C (“regional office”) was rejected on every observed ticket, including when the message mentioned a regional office. Do not infer or select C.
- Valid choices were A (standard queue) and B (priority desk); some ticket displays omitted or truncated C, reinforcing that displayed options must be followed exactly.
- For large requests, prefer B (priority desk) unless additional evidence indicates otherwise.
- Sender team, request type (shipment/invoice/refund), and wording such as “second attempt” or repeated client follow-up did not establish a different routing rule.
